title: Network Security Fundamentals
description: Security preliminaries, CIA triad, access control models, vulnerability categories, and network attack types (DoS/DDoS, sniffing, social engineering, malware, buffer overflow).
learning_objectives: Define security incident and explain the security-as-a-process concept
Explain confidentiality, integrity, availability, and non-repudiation (CIA+N)
Describe access control models: MAC, DAC, RoBAC, and RuBAC
Explain PKI, digital certificates, and the role of CA and RA
Categorise vulnerabilities: people, hardware/transmission, protocol/software, Internet-access
Classify attacks by attacker profile: opportunistic, intermediate, and sophisticated
Explain DoS/DDoS variants: SYN flood, ping of death, teardrop, smurf, UDP/ICMP flood
Describe buffer overflow, IP sniffing, social engineering, phishing, and malware types
